Tidy tables from a within/between correlation comparison

Source: R/stats_correlate_levels.R
as.data.frame.idiographic_level_correlations.Rd

Tidy tables from a within/between correlation comparison

Usage

# S3 method for class 'idiographic_level_correlations'
as.data.frame(
  x,
  row.names = NULL,
  optional = FALSE,
  what = c("correlations", "summary"),
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A correlate_levels() result.

row.names, optional

Ignored.

what

"correlations" (one row per correlation) or "summary" (one row per pair of variables, as summary()).

...

Ignored.

Value

A data.frame: for "correlations", one row per level, unit and pair of variables (level, unit, x, y, n, r, ...), where the unit is a person for level = "within" and an occasion for level = "between"; for "summary", one row per pair of variables comparing the levels.

Examples

lv <- correlate_levels(srl, id = "name", vars = c("efficacy", "effort"),
                       time = "day")
as.data.frame(lv)
